question: Can old storage hydration work publish or persist after setOptions transfers ownership to a replacement storage backend?

sources.name: Pinned Zustand persist source
sources.claim: Hydration binds the initiating storage read while later migration persistence uses mutable current storage; setOptions could replace storage without advancing hydration authority.

sources.name: Repaired storage-replacement candidate
sources.claim: Only actual storage-object replacement advances the hydration generation; identical-object reapplication preserves current hydration.

command: pnpm run test:format && pnpm run test:types && pnpm run test:lint && pnpm run test:spec

distinguishing_outcomes.observation: Old read applies and old migration writes through replacement storage on the characterization head.
distinguishing_outcomes.interpretation: Storage ownership transfer does not invalidate earlier hydration authority.

distinguishing_outcomes.observation: Candidate suppresses old publication and cross-backend writes after actual replacement while later hydration succeeds.
distinguishing_outcomes.interpretation: Advancing the existing generation at storage-object replacement is a narrow authority repair.

distinguishing_outcomes.observation: Reapplying the identical storage object preserves the active hydration and completion signals.
distinguishing_outcomes.interpretation: No-op storage assignment must remain distinct from ownership transfer.

distinguishing_outcomes.observation: Exact-head format, type, lint, spec, identity, and hygiene gates pass or fail.
distinguishing_outcomes.interpretation: Use only the fresh repaired-head result for promotion; prior green receipts are provenance.

stop_condition: Stop after the repaired exact head passes the complete repository gate and the final two-file diff is reviewed unchanged.
